controls: Actual uv_exepath and uv_cwd observations; no substitute OS operation or forced fallback.
Windows and Linux branches use their actual original selected PathResolve body. Tests do not infer common platform semantics.
SafeGetenv cases require the real credential admission, and fail if the host disallows it. No admission bypass or coverage suppression.
Trace tests observe only declared synchronous callback selection, order and value snapshots. They do not claim native or JS stack output.
Native allocation failure uses the existing actual std::new_handler retry adapter and restores the native quota. No JS OOM is substituted.
Prior ordinary and actually thrown flagged Error identity is retained while native strings operate under real JS heap limit1.
Placement memory has a separate native entitlement, and test15 releases the caller Map entitlement while original SafeGetenv still holds it.
